title: A registry's config.json (spec/registry.md section 1, ADR-011 D1)
description: format: the registry format (1; a client refuses another with "update bb"). dl: the archive URL template with {id} and {vers}, absolute or relative to the registry's URL. keys: the registry's minisign public keys (informative; the trusted key is compiled into bb or written in bb.toml).
